summary: MakeMyEvents (Expo/RN + FastAPI) MVP verified. All 11 backend pytest cases pass and login screen renders + redirects to Emergent auth correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in RN Web — use 'boxShadow' (cosmetic, non-blocking)

get_current_user duplicated on every endpoint — could be refactored into a FastAPI Depends dependency for cleaner code.
